verdict.rationale: GitHub runs a first-party Marketplace for integrations ('Build on your workflow with apps that integrate with GitHub', 'Tools from the community and partners'). It lists concrete third-party apps such as Render, Lovable, GitHub for Atlassian/Jira, Slack, Shopify and mobile CI/CD, and GitHub markets this as extending your stack with apps, actions and AI models. missing for 10: documentation of the actual install/authorization flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of installing an app.
